name: Window Tiling
description: Fill the screen with the focused window, or put it on a half of the screen, through the window tiling of Hammerspoon.
author: Yujun Huang

commands.name: Fill Window
commands.description: Fill the screen with the focused window, as Control-Option-Return does.

commands.name: Left Half
commands.description: Put the focused window on the left half of the screen, as Control-Option-Left does.

commands.name: Right Half
commands.description: Put the focused window on the right half of the screen, as Control-Option-Right does.

commands.name: Top Half
commands.description: Put the focused window on the top half of the screen, as Control-Option-Up does.

commands.name: Bottom Half
commands.description: Put the focused window on the bottom half of the screen, as Control-Option-Down does.
